indicators.section: Indicators additional scrutiny might be warranted (account opening)
indicators.flag: Inconsistencies among multiple identity documents submitted by the customer;
indicators.red_flag: Inconsistent multi-document ID set at onboarding (synthetic-ID tell)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Indicators additional scrutiny might be warranted (account opening)
indicators.flag: A customer's inability to satisfactorily authenticate their identity, source of income, or another aspect of their profile;
indicators.red_flag: Customer cannot authenticate identity / source-of-income / profile
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Indicators additional scrutiny might be warranted (account opening)
indicators.flag: Inconsistencies between the identity document and other aspects of the customer's profile.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Access to an account from an IP address that is inconsistent with the customer's profile;
indicators.red_flag: Account access from profile-inconsistent IP (device/geo anomaly)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Patterns of apparent coordinated activity among multiple similar accounts;
indicators.red_flag: Coordinated activity across multiple similar accounts (account-farm ring)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: High payment volumes to potentially higher-risk payees, such as gambling websites or digital asset exchanges;
indicators.red_flag: High-volume payouts to gambling / digital-asset-exchange payees
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: High volumes of chargebacks or rejected payments;
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D1.

indicators.flag: Patterns of rapid transactions by a newly opened account or an account with little prior transaction history; and
indicators.red_flag: Rapid transactions on newly opened / thin-history account
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.flag: Patterns of withdrawing funds immediately after deposit and in manners that make payments difficult to reverse in cases of suspected fraud, such as through international bank transfers or payments to offshore digital asset exchanges and gambling sites.
indicators.red_flag: Deposit-then-immediate irreversible drawdown (international wire / offshore crypto)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A customer's photo is internally inconsistent (e.g., shows visual tells of being altered) or is inconsistent with their other identifying information (e.g., a customer's date of birth indicates that they are much older or younger than the photo would suggest).
indicators.red_flag: Altered / age-mismatched customer photo (deepfake image tell)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A customer presents multiple identity documents that are inconsistent with each other.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A customer uses a third-party webcam plugin during a live verification check.  Alternatively, a customer attempts to change communication methods during a live verification check due to excessive or suspicious technological glitches during remote verification of their identity.
indicators.red_flag: Webcam-plugin / channel-switch to evade live verification
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A customer declines to use multifactor authentication to verify their identity.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A reverse-image lookup or open-source search of an identity photo matches an image in an online gallery of GenAI-produced faces.
indicators.red_flag: ID photo matches GenAI-face gallery (reverse-image OSINT hit)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse

indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: GenAI-detection software flags the potential use of GenAI text in a customer's profile or responses to prompts.
indicators.red_flag: GenAI-text detector flags customer profile / prompt responses
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A customer's geographic or device data is inconsistent with the customer's identity documents.

indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D9 (Identity-verification, document & device/session telemetry), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Deepfake Media Abuse
indicators.flag: A newly opened account or an account with little prior transaction history has a pattern of rapid transactions; high payment volumes to potentially risky payees, such as gambling websites or digital asset exchanges; or high volumes of chargebacks or rejected payments.
indicators.red_flag: Thin-history account: rapid txns + risky-payee payouts + chargebacks
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).
